# Animas Reflections

> Custom apparel, merchandise and embroidery in Durango, Colorado. Screen printing, embroidery,
> sublimation and small-batch goods, produced to order. The shop runs on a static Next.js storefront
> with Firebase and Square (payment only).

## What we do

- Custom screen printing, embroidery and sublimation on apparel and merchandise
- Design help: upload artwork or describe an idea, and we refine placement and sizing with you
- Fundraising programs for teams, schools and organisations
- Sub-brands: Biscuit Hockey, I'M OK R U

- Privacy policy: https://animas-reflections-pwa.web.app/privacy/

## Notes for automated agents

- Prices, availability and shipping rates are rendered from live data; the shipping page states the
  same rates checkout charges.
- Product pages use a query string (`/product/?id=…`); canonicals are per product.
- Ordering requires a card through Square. The site never stores card numbers.
- For quotes on bulk or corporate orders, use the contact page rather than a product listing.
